notes.title: 2025/9/16 Update
notes.content: [h2]1.The sound effect volume of the electromagnetic artillery tower is reduced.[/h2][h2]2. Changes to the Vampire Tower[/h2][p]The negative effect description of "50% damage reduction" for the ultimate skill in Roguelike mode has been removed[/p][p]In fact, this was not implemented before.[/p][p]The blood-sucking rate of the meat pigeon mode has been upgraded from 50% to 30%, and the health point upgrade has been increased from 40% to 50%.[/p][p](The previous upgrade of the vampire rate actually increased damage. This Bug has been fixed.)[/p][p]The specialized blood-sucking rate has been upgraded from 30% to 20%[/p][p]The blood absorption rate of the common Vampire Tower has increased from 200% to 600%, and the damage has decreased from 60 to 30.[/p][p]The shared blood-sucking rate has increased from 200% to 600%, and the damage has decreased from 30 to 15.[/p][p]The vampire recovery rate has increased from 100% to 300%, and the damage has decreased from 60 to 30.[/p][p]Previously, the Vampire Tower could be used to deal damage, and its positioning slightly overlapped with that of the Laser tower.[/p][p]Now the damage has decreased but the blood-sucking rate has increased, making it more suitable for the current rank.[/p][p]The upgrade and modification have reduced the stable damage that the Vampire Tower can withstand in the later stage, and the health bonus has enhanced its survival ability in the face of burst damage.[/p][h2]3. Changes to support stations[/h2][p]The overflow recovery revenue from meat pigeons and modifications has decreased from 0.5% to 0.2%.[/p][p]The penalty for modification overflow recycling has been changed from "100% increase in cost and electricity" to "100% increase in cost".[/p][p]Previously, this modification increased the power demand, which was equivalent to halving the number of support stations and weakening their original functions.[/p][p]Now, only the initial construction cost is sacrificed to increase the later income, which will not affect its original function.[/p][p]Previously, overflow recovery was still effective for a period of time after the support station was destroyed. Now, overflow recovery can only take effect if the support station is built and still alive.[/p]

notes.title: 2025/9/13 Update
notes.content: [p]1. The English text has been improved, and the Steam page now supports English.[/p][p]The survival mode has added four maps, making a total of five maps now.[/p][p]3. Modification of the laser tower[/p][p]The specialized range bonus of the laser tower has been reduced from 10 to 5.[/p][p]The range of the charged laser tower has been reduced from 75 to 50.[/p][p]The base damage of the amplification laser tower has been reduced from 50 to 30, and its range has been increased from 75 to 120.[/p][p]4. Modification of the rifle tower[/p][p]The specialized armor penetration bonus of the rifle tower has been reduced from 10% to 5%, and the range bonus has been reduced from 20% to 10%.[/p][p]The range of the long-range rifle tower has been increased from 100 to 150.[/p][p]The modification of the rifle tower to a "slow rifle" will now also reduce the ballistic speed by 50%, including the acceleration and maximum speed of the long-range rifle tower.[/p][p]The issue where the power correction of the modified "Slow Rifle" was ineffective has been fixed.[/p][p]5. Changes to the Vampire Tower[/p][p]The midpoint of the Vampire Tower's effect is now the center of the hit unit, and previously it was the center of the target unit.[/p][p]6. Modification of the missile tower[/p][p]The range of missile towers and multi-fired missile towers has decreased, while the turning speed of the turrets and the acceleration of the shells have increased.[/p][p]After upgrading the "capacity" technology of the continuous launch missile tower, the upper limit of the model's light effect has increased from 12 to 24. (Similar to the rapid interception tower)[/p][p]The range of the vertical launch missile tower has been reduced, and the damage has increased from 600 to 1,200.[/p][p]7. Modification of unmanned aerial vehicle base stations[/p][p]The operating radius of the unmanned aerial vehicle base station has been increased from 500 to 750.[/p][p]8. Modification of the machine gun tower[/p][p]The machine gun tower specialization no longer reduces the spread and power requirements, but increases the range by 10 and the close-range damage bonus by 20%. This effect is similar to the close-range defense technology in the meat pigeon mode.[/p][p]The actual damage of the shell =(Max(1- horizontal flight distance/range,0)* close-range damage bonus +1)* damage.[/p][p]The initial close-range damage bonus is 0.[/p][p]9. Enemy changes[/p][p]The range of anti-aircraft artillery has been increased from 125 to 150, and the stop distance has been increased from 100 to 140.[/p][p]10. In survival mode, enemies now spawn in large numbers at certain locations from time to time. The refresh types are randomly combined.[/p][p]The wavelet refresh base period is 30 seconds, accounting for 30% of the total force.[/p][p]The major wave refreshed the base period by 120 seconds, accounting for 30% of the total force.[/p][p]Continuous refresh accounts for 40%.[/p][p]Both small waves and large waves have a 70% probability of refreshing from a certain point and a 30% probability of refreshing in all directions.[/p][p]The connection between the enemy's resources and the quantity of construction has become more "flexible". For instance, if a large number of enemies have just been refreshed, the frequency of refreshing will decrease in the following period of time. That is to say, the refresh rate fluctuates over time, but in the long run, it still increases and stabilizes with time.[/p][p]11. The manual operation of the third-person perspective switch in the roguelike mode has been optimized.[/p][p]Some descriptions have been modified. The technology button with insufficient technology points is now red.[/p][p]12. Fixed the issue where the roguelike and survival mode siege robots would be drawn to the units behind them with hatred but would not turn their heads.[/p]

notes.title: 2025/8/15 Update
notes.content: [p]1. Fixed the issue where the base was not damaged by splashes. (Even completely immune to self-detonation balls)[/p][p]2. Fixed the issue of manual operation to empty the second picture of the meat pigeon.[/p][p]3. Fixed the issue where the start button was not red when there were no two advanced support stations in Roguelike mode.[/p][p]4. Fixed the issue where torpedoes could not attack.[/p][p]5. Fixed the issue where there was a probability that no enemies would appear on a certain day in the level mode.[/p][p]6. The random map in survival mode has been removed and replaced with a fixed map.[/p][p]The time interval for data statistics at the end has been changed from 1 second to 10 seconds.[/p][p]8. When a building cannot be constructed due to insufficient resources but an attempt is made, a prompt will be displayed asking why the operation cannot be performed. Similar prompts should also be given in other situations.[/p][p]9. Fixed the issue of excessive "Void Blood-sucking" in the shared blood-sucking tower.[/p][p]10. The loading speed of meat pigeons and survival mode has been accelerated.[/p][p]11. Now the day and night effects of all maps are unified.[/p][p]12. Currently, in all three modes, 50%* health percentage of the cost will be refunded for units that are demolished (except for survival mode), and no refund will be given for units that are destroyed.[/p][p]13. Changes in survival mode[/p][p]In survival mode, the unit cost becomes 250%. When demolished, 80% of the cost of health is returned, meaning that the resources lost when demolished at full health remain unchanged.[/p][p]After reaching the selected duration, no more enemies will emerge. Victory is achieved after eliminating all remaining enemies.[/p][p]The base income and shield upgrade have been changed from level 4 to level 9, which is smoother.[/p][p]The shield range of the base has been greatly reduced. Now the map structure is more complex. You need to defend at multiple points rather than just spreading out around the base.[/p][p]Enemies no longer refresh bosses.[/p][p]Unlock new types of enemies every day for the first four days.[/p][p]The types of enemies are no longer simply random but are randomly weighted based on cost. Therefore, there will be more small units than large ones.[/p][p]14. The survival mode has added a "Doomsday Mode".[/p][p]In the doomsday mode, if victory is not possible, the number of enemies will no longer increase after the selected duration ends. However, every 6 minutes (i.e., one day in the game), the enemy's health will increase by 40% and their damage by 20%. This bonus multiplicates and accumulates, resulting in 1.96 times the health and 1.44 times the damage on the second day. Superimpose with other gain multiplications.[/p][p]The growth factor will reach its maximum effect at the end of the selected duration and will not increase thereafter.[/p][p]The difficulty of the survival mode will be higher than that of other modes. You need more resources to build a defense line, but the cost of changing strategies remains the same. You need to be more careful to prevent the unit from being destroyed.[/p]

notes.title: 2025/7/27 Update
notes.content: [p]1. General enemy AI modification[/p][p]Previously, I would stop when the distance between myself and the target was less than the stop distance.[/p][p]It will now stop when the distance between itself and the nearest attacking target is less than the stop distance. .[/p][p]This attacking target refers to the ground and air attributes of the unit itself rather than the weapon. For instance, anti-aircraft artillery will only stop near ground units and not near air units.[/p][p]A condition that needs to be met simultaneously is that at least one weapon can attack any unit, and this condition remains the same as before.[/p][p]The setting of the scope of hatred has been cancelled.[/p][p]2. AI changes for enemies in survival and Roguelike modes[/p][p]Most of the enemies now only move towards the base, which means you can't attract their hatred in any way.[/p][p]For instance, grappling units such as electromagnetic levitation vehicles and fast gunboats will move towards the nearest unit, just as in the level mode.[/p][p]Both types of bombers will only move with the base as their target, but they will drop bombs as long as there are ground units within the attack range.[/p][p]This change will require you to adjust your response strategy according to the type of the enemy.[/p][p]For instance, you can build some artillery towers far from the base. Ordinary tanks won't deliberately attack them, but electromagnetic levitation vehicles will do so on purpose.[/p][p]You can build cheap units at a distance to draw the enemy's hatred, but this can only attract units like the electromagnetic levitation vehicle. You still need to deal with most of the units head-on.[/p][p]The modification of the bombers enables you to avoid having to deal with a large number of bombers attacking one position simultaneously, but it also means that you need to place anti-aircraft units in advance along the movement path of any bomber.[/p][p]3. Both types of bombers now have initial ballistic speeds and will calculate their trajectories to aim at targets and attack, just like other weapons.[/p][p]This modification is made to align with the aforementioned changes. Therefore, you cannot deceive the AI into missing the attack at the edge of the attack range.[/p][p]The range of the corresponding bombers is slightly reduced because the inertia lead time no longer needs to be taken into account.[/p][p]The initial ballistic velocity of the bomber is a fixed total ballistic velocity. (Other similar attacks have a fixed horizontal ballistic speed.)[/p][p]The attacks of bombers now come with their own dispersion.[/p][p]4. A brand-new UI has been updated.[/p][p]5. Now, Esc can close most Windows, and each press will only close one window.[/p][p]6. Fixed the issue where the hardened shield tower technology obtained resources before starting in the meat pigeon mode.[/p]

notes.title: 2025/7/18 Update
notes.content: [p]1.The loading screen has been changed to a random image.[/p][p]2. The description of the heavy armor factor has been changed.[/p][p]3. Group numbers have been added to the main menu.[/p][p]4. There is now also a hit effect when the shield rebounds.[/p][p]5. When switching the roguelike mode map to a map without save, the save description will also be updated. (The previous save description is still from the previous map.)[/p][p]6. The priority of the continuous launch missile tower is now the highest for the Air Force.[/p][p]7. The priority of light machine gun towers is now the closest to the Air Force.[/p][p]8. Fixed the issue where the self-detonating ball artillery locked onto the air force under the land-air integration factor.[/p][p]9. Fixed the issue where the resonant sniper cannon sometimes had horizontal effects. (Especially when attacking distant targets or missing a shot[/p][p]10. Now, when enemies refresh in Roguelike mode, they always face the center of the map.[/p][p]11. Fixed the issue where save files were not deleted after clearing the Roguelike mode.[/p]

notes.title: 2025/7/15 Update
notes.content: [h2]The Rogue mode has been changed[/h2][p]The maximum duration has been reduced from 5 minutes to 3 minutes, while the total number of enemies remains unchanged.[/p][p]2. The drone is cleared at the end of the wave.[/p][h2]bug fix[/h2][p]Fixed the issue where additional satellites were not moving.[/p]

notes.title: 2025/7/14 Update
notes.content: [p]1. The function of modifying speed has been added. The default shortcut keys are the numeric keypad + and -, with a range of 0.5 to 4.[/p][p]When the frame rate is low, the actual acceleration effect will be reduced. The frame rate/speed will not be less than 30.[/p][p]2. Fixed the issue where the unit's pathfinding got stuck.[/p]

notes.title: 2025/7/13 Update2
notes.content: [h2]The Rogue mode has been changed[/h2][p]1. The desert dust effect has been changed to a reduced range.[/p][p]Range coefficient =1/ (1+ sandstorm intensity *3)[/p][p]2. Reduce the size of the spiral graph and the desert graph.[/p][p]3. The lock view will automatically close after the wave ends.[/p]

notes.title: 2025/7/13 Update
notes.content: [h2]The Rogue mode has been changed[/h2][p]Three new maps have been added. Each has its own environmental factor, and the intensity of each wave of the environmental factor effect is random between 20% and 100%.[/p][p]Ice field[/p][p]The operational efficiency of all weapons is reduced by 60% through multiplication calculation.[/p][p]Acidic marsh[/p][p]All units' armor and health recovery rates are reduced by 100%, and this effect is calculated at the final damage settlement.[/p][p]Buildings cannot be constructed in the acid lake, but it is passable.[/p][p]Units on the Acid Lake take 5% of their maximum health per second of non-armor-piercing damage. Although the damage value is not related to the intensity of the environment, the actual damage will be higher due to the stronger acid mist in the armor settlement.[/p][p]Desert[/p][p]The sand and dust have reduced the operational efficiency of all weapons by 90%. By division calculation, the effect is related to the intensity of the wind and sand at the location of the unit.[/p][p]Operational efficiency = Operational efficiency/(1+9* Wind and sand intensity)[/p][p]2. The initial resources for each wave change from 2000*x to 2000*x+1000*x*x, where x represents the number of waves.[/p][p]3. Lock the view by switching F to whether it is locked and G to lock the mode. It was always F before.[/p][p]4. Fixed the bug where saving unit areas during file reading would be regarded as non-buildable areas.[/p]

notes.title: 2025/7/5 Update
notes.content: [h2]The Rogue mode has been changed[/h2][p]1.A new map has been added. In this map, there is only one direction where enemies attack, but the number of enemies has increased by 50%. This effect is multiplied and superimposed with other effects.[/p][p]Each map is archived separately.[/p][p]2. Enemy hatred has added a limit: the Angle between (enemy - unit) and (enemy - base) is less than 90 degrees. That is to say, units behind the enemy will not attract hatred.[/p]

notes.title: 2025/7/4 Update
notes.content: [h2]The Rogue mode has been changed[/h2][p]1. The map is changed to be non-random. Instead, a map is selected and the same map is used for all 30 waves. After the wave ends, the map will no longer be loaded. Units that did not die before will be retained, but the total construction resources remain unchanged. The retention is only to reduce operations. You cannot start when the resource is negative.[/p][p]2. There is no longer a restriction that the construction location must be near the base.[/p][p]3. Most of the enemies now only use the base as their moving target point. When the player's units can be attacked, the enemies will stop to attack. The two types of bombers still moved with the nearest unit as their target.[/p][p]Therefore, you can place units on the enemy's movement route directly to the base, but you cannot place units at a distance when the enemy is already approaching the base to attract hatred.[/p][p]The survival mode will also be modified to a similar mechanism later.[/p][p]4. The price increase factor has been changed to the heavy armor factor. For every 50% of the maximum health damage received, the armor increases by 100%, the upper limit is 100%, and it decreases by 10% per second.[/p][p]5. Randomness has been changed to seed generation. In the Roguelike mode, once the save file is established, the seeds are fixed. Therefore, whether it is a failed retry or continuing the game, the enemy configuration and factors of a certain wave will not change.[/p]

notes.title: 2025/6/14 Update
notes.content: [p]1. The tutorial level has been removed. Now the tutorial is embedded in the game and can be set to switch.[/p][p]2. The modification was moved from the Settings to the level selection interface.[/p][p]3. In the Roguelike mode, technology points and initial resources are now separate. The initial resources will only increase as the number of levels increases.[/p][p]4. The ordinary sniper tower is now ground-to-air and air-to-air.[/p][p]5. The manual operation of the Roguelike mode is now carried out after pressing F to lock the perspective. One lock is for free-angle shooting, and the second lock is for third-person shooting with the left mouse button.[/p][p]When the second lock occurs, the rolling pulley will change the height of the camera. When you are controlling a unit located in a stack of towers and your field of view is blocked by other units, you may need to increase the field of view.[/p][p]6. The loading screen now features random tips.[/p][p]7. Now, when building continuously, you don't need to hold down shift. Just right-click and cancel the building.[/p][p]There are currently two continuous construction methods. It can be switched in the Settings.[/p][p](1) Quick: It's the current effect. Hold down the left mouse button and fill in the nearest area directly. Holding down shift will cause the unit to be filled only at the integer multiple offset position[/p][p](2) Neatness: Pressing the mouse will display the model. Moving the mouse will generate multiple models along the line from the first model to the current mouse position. Releasing the mouse will build a line of units. When holding down shift, the direction of the pull line will only be an integer multiple of 45 degrees.[/p][p]Press and hold the left mouse button while pressing the right mouse button to cancel. The position of the first unit is the buildable position closest to where the mouse is pressed. The relative horizontal offset of the subsequent unit positions must be equal. If the subsequent unit position cannot be built, it will not be generated, and all subsequent units along its extension line will not be generated.[/p][p]Simply put, in the neat mode, the units you build for a line must be neat.[/p][p]8. The upgraded construction has now been cancelled, and the three types of units of the same type are now on an equal footing.[/p]

notes.title: 2025/6/7 Update
notes.content: [h2]Bug fix[/h2][p]The issue that might cause the game to freeze when switching levels has been fixed. I tested it over 600 times and didn't encounter the problem again. It seems to have been fixed.[/p]

notes.title: 2025/6/5 Update
notes.content:
[h2] Special Effects Update [/h2]
1.The unit explosion effect has been redone and is no longer bound to units. Previously, the black mark on the ground would suddenly disappear a few seconds after a unit's death when removed, but now it won't.
[h2] Roguelike Mode Update [/h2]
1. The shutdown factor has been changed to a rebound. The enemy's damage is halved but rebounds by 20%.
2. The reward factor has been changed to blood-sucking. Enemies are halved but gain 100% blood-sucking.
3. A challenge switch has been added. It can be turned on in the Enemy type panel. Once turned on, the enemy's health will be doubled (multiplication and superposition). If won, the reward of technology points will also be doubled.
4. Two new maps, "Crack" and "Desert", have been added to the random map, and the existing three maps have been redone.
5. The duration of each level has changed from 10 to 200 seconds to 20 to 300 seconds.
[h2]UI Update [/h2]
1. A loading image has been added to the main menu, but it is not available after entering the game. For instance, in the Roguelike mode, the image is not loaded when entering the next level. It will be modified together later.
[h2] Mechanism Update [/h2
1.The slope movement bonus has changed from ±60% at 30 degrees to ±60% at 6 degrees.
[h2]Bug Fix [/h2]
1.I attempted to fix the issue that might cause the Roguelike mode to freeze when switching levels, but since it's hard to replicate, I'm not sure if it has been fixed.

notes.title: 2025/6/1 Update
notes.content:
[h2] Roguelike Mode Update [/h2]
The clearance score (1- failure rate) has been increased.
1.100% : SSS failed 0 times
2.95% to 100% : SS failed once
3.90% to 95% : S fails 2 to 3 times
4.80% to 90% : A fails 4 to 6 times
5.60% to 80% : B fails 7 to 12 times
6.30% to 60% : C failed 13 to 21 times
7.0% to 30% : D failed 22 to 30 times
8.-50% to 0% : E failed 31 to 45 times
9.-∞ to -50% : F fails 46-∞ times

1.From now on, units can also be dismantled, but the returned resources will be the cost * current health percentage *0.5. Before the start, 100% will still be returned.
2. Nowadays, when building units, they do not choose the units.
3. Manual aiming in the present tense starts from the camera for detection rather than behind it. For example, in the air mode, if the field of view is too low, resulting in no air position for the mouse, the turret will not rotate. Previously, it would rotate to a point on the reverse extension line.
4. The total number of waves in each round has become two-thirds of the previous one, meaning there are more enemies in each wave. In addition, the quantity of each wave changes from constant to: 0.5 times at the beginning and 1.5 times at the end. That is, there will be more and more enemies within one game.
The maximum duration has been shortened from 300 seconds to 200 seconds.
6. Large waves have been added.
The last wave of levels 1 to 10 accounts for 20% of the total enemies, and the remaining time is 80% of the enemies.
From Level 11 to Level 20, there is an additional 10% of the enemy's wave in half of the time, and 70% of the enemy's wave in the remaining time.
From level 21 to level 30, there are two waves of 10% enemies for 1/3 and 2/3 of the time, and 60% enemies for the remaining time.
7. The progress bar and the number of units are displayed. The number only includes the enemies that spawn, and the self-destruct balls generated by the units are not counted. The length of the progress bar represents the total cost of the enemy, which can be understood as combat power.
Blue represents those that have been eliminated, yellow represents those that remain on the field, red represents those that have not yet appeared, and deep red represents large waves.
[h2] Other updates [/h2]
1. The screen shake effect has been added and can be modified in the Settings. When some weapons are fired and hit, the explosion of units will cause the screen to shake.
[h2]Bug Fix [/h2]
1.Fixed the issue where the main menu's encyclopedia was blurred.

notes.title: 2025/5/29 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Roguelike mode update[/h2]
This update has significantly optimized the game pace.
1.The upper limit of speed variation when moving up and down slopes has been reduced from 80% to 60%.
2.The maximum height damage bonus has been reduced from 50% to 40%.
3.The upper limit of the types that enemies can refresh has been increased from 4 to 5.
4. The wave count and quantity of enemies in the later stage have been increased.
5. Added difficulty options. Change the total number and wave count of enemies that appear. The higher difficulty mainly affects the high wavenumber, and there is little difference between the low wavenumber and the high wavenumber.
6. Now you can manually operate the gunboat and the air superiority machine. For wasd movement, it's better to press f to lock the viewing Angle first and then operate.
Manual operation and automatic operation are slightly different, for example:
The gunboat was originally designed to move and turn separately, meaning it could move laterally. Manual operation could only move forward and backward.
The unit was originally capable of flying out of the map boundary. However, as you may sometimes see the turning radius, manual operation cannot fly out of the map.
7. The technology tree has been balanced.
The main reason is that the technology prices of advanced units have become more expensive. Then there are some sporadic minor changes.
The vertical distribution zeroing technology of the common machine gun tower has been replaced with armor-piercing +50% technology. Now, the common machine gun tower is very suitable for shooting high-armor units.
[h2]Bug fix[/h2]
1.The issue where the continuous resource acquisition technology of the recycling Vampire tower was dozens of times higher than the displayed value has been fixed.

notes.title: 2025/5/27 Update2
notes.content:
[h2]Optimization update[/h2]
1.The frame rate of the Roguelike mode has been optimized. Previously, when the same unit number was applied, the frame rate would be about 40% lower than that of other modes.
[h2]Other updates[/h2]
1.In the Roguelike mode, the range of sound effects played by manually operated units has been expanded.
2. The multiple of the sound effect range has been increased in the Settings.
[h2]Bug fix[/h2]
1.Fixed the issue where there was a probability of error reporting and freezing in survival mode and Roguelike mode.

notes.title: 2025/5/27 Update
notes.content:
[h2]UI Update [/h2]
1.Some of the UI has been optimized.
2. The UI has added sound effects, and the volume can be adjusted in the Settings.
[h2] Roguelike Mode Update [/h2]
1.A win-loss interface will pop up at the end.
2. The list of enemies that appear in this game has been changed to a button, allowing you to jump to the pokedex.
3. The air force's refresh points are dispersed to prevent overlapping of bombers.
4. Manual operation has added a crosswire to display the current aiming position, aiming at the air or ground, and the target to be aimed at (if any).
[h2]Bug Fix [/h2]
1.Fixed the issue where it would get stuck at the Tech Tree interface when opening the Roguelike mode for the first time.
2. Fixed the issue where the conventional mode self-explosive ball transport aircraft did not place self-explosive balls.
3. Fixed the issue where the Roguelike mode's recovery of the Vampire Tower and the shared Vampire tower had no damage.

notes.title: 2025/5/25 Update
notes.content:
[h2] Roguelike Mode Update [/h2]
1.The enemy refresh time is more uniform and increases with the growth of the level.
2. Random factors have been added. Random factors appear in each level, providing both positive and negative effects simultaneously.
3. For every 5 levels passed, the enemy's base health attack increases by 0.5 times and the cost increases by 0.5 times. This effect is superimposed with the multiplication of random factors.

notes.title: 2025/5/24 Update
notes.content:
[h2] New Mode [/h2]
The "Classic Mode" has been added.
Defeat enemies of random waves in different random maps. The technology points will increase at the end of each level.
After entering the map, the initial resource values will be consistent with the technology points. Only after the game starts will the resources be enhanced in other ways. Upgrading technology will cost technology points and resources, while building units only cost resources.
In this mode, if a unit is destroyed, resources will not be returned. If it is dismantled, all resources will be returned. After the game starts, units cannot be dismantled or technologies upgraded.

[h2] Gameplay Update [/h2]
The random map increases the upper limit of the number of enemies and the rate at which income grows over time.
[h2]Bug Fix [/h2]
1. Fixed some issues with the save Boss.
2. Fixed some issues with the summary of archived data.
3. Fixed some issues where income and expenditure types were not included in the data summary.
4. Fixed the issue where units could not be built after random map reading and saving.

notes.title: 2025/5/15 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay update[/h2]
1.The archiving function has been added.
At present, some content cannot be saved, which will result in the loss of certain data after reading. It will be fixed later.
2. A settlement system has been added, and a summary of various data will be displayed at the end of the game.
3. The armor-piercing artillery Tower no longer detects nearby air forces. If it happens to hit an air force, it will cause damage to that air force and continue to search for non-air force units nearby.
[h2]UI Update[/h2]
1.The unit panel now displays the modification type.
2. Added the wasd moving perspective.
3. The annotations on the power panel now show the number of power stations.
[h2]Bug fix[/h2]
1.The issue that leakage power stations could cause harm to the air force has been fixed.
2. Fixed the Bug where difficulty health points affected the Boss twice.

notes.title: 2025/5/10 Update
notes.content:
[h2] Gameplay Update [/h2]
1. A "Modification" system has been added. The modification system can be modified in the Settings and applied at the beginning of the game. That is to say, making modifications in the game will not affect this round.
At the beginning of the game, the unit is in a paused state before it is built. At this time, it can still be modified. Once it starts, it will be locked.
Modifying the system will not affect the tutorial.
The impact of the modified system on the unit attributes will be displayed in the pokedex. If it is in the main menu, the modified encyclopedia will be modified immediately. If it is in a game, the modification impact of this round will be displayed.
2. The base height of the random map dunes is now smoother.
3. Now, when the laser tower and the vampire tower hit the target, the hit position will change to the center position of the hit target. This will also affect the determination of the sputtering range.
[h2]UI Update [/h2]
The cost and power demand displayed by the icon of the construction list will now be calculated for specialization and variant effects.
2. The random map duration selection range is now 20 to 100, with a step size of 5.
[h2]Bug Fix [/h2]
Fixed the issue where the power demand of the defense support station was not affected by specialization.

notes.title: 2025/5/8Update
notes.content:
[h2] Gameplay Update [/h2]
1.The base shield upgrade in the random map now has a transition effect.
2. The collision limit for unit pathfinding has been reduced. That is to say, you will now see that the Boss can pass through narrower terrain, but it will somewhat penetrate the mountain.
3. The Boss from the first level will now appear on the random map, but the Boss's model will shrink by 20%, while other data remains unchanged. Refresh every 5 minutes starting from 15 minutes.
4. The resources of enemies in the random map are now increasing twice, while previously it was once.
[h2]UI Update [/h2]
The core recovery values of the shield in the second level and the random map now show the results after the impact of operational efficiency. Previously, strengthening the shield also accelerated the core recovery speed of the shield, but the unit panel did not display the effect.
[h2] Picture update [/h2]
1.The acidic marsh map has added post-treatment effects under the acid liquid.
2. The graphics and layout of the second and third levels of the random map have been optimized.
3. When building units in the random map, the buildable areas are displayed.
4. The terrain material around the buildings in the random map will change to steel plates, and the buildings will be restored after being destroyed.

notes.title: 2025/5/6Update
notes.content:
[h2]Level Update[/h2]
A brand-new game mode has been added! Random map.
In this mode, the map is randomly generated. There are no mining machines on the map, but you have an initial base that can provide continuous income and upgrade the income.
The base will also provide an ellipsoidal shield that is not damaged by splashing, which requires resources to activate and upgrade.
Your building can only be constructed near the already built one.
There is a fog of war. The higher the level of the unit, the farther the field of vision. Units of the same level, your unit has a farther field of vision than the enemy. The range of most advanced units is higher than their own field of vision, so other units need to open their field of vision.
Enemies will respawn from the passable areas at the edge of the map. The enemy has its own economic system, with an upper limit on electricity and resource income. The income will increase over time. And new types of enemies will be gradually unlocked over time.
The failure condition of this mode is the destruction of the base, and the victory condition is survival for a certain period of time. The survival time can be chosen by oneself.
Current random map levels:
1.Wavy sand dunes, undulating terrain without any obstacles.
2.Acidic marsh, net-like path, no terrain blocking the trajectory.
3.Net-like canyons, net-like paths, and terrain blocking the trajectory.
Later, artistic details will be added to the random map.

notes.title: 2025/5/3 Update
notes.content:
[h3]UI Update [/h3
The resolution option now allows you to select other values.
2. The specialized panels have been reordered in the order of the towers.
[h3] Gameplay Update [/h3]
The overheating time of the light machine gun tower has increased from 10 seconds to 40 seconds, while the overheating decay time remains at 10 seconds. That is to say, the light machine gun tower has been accurate for a longer time.
2. The specialization fee has been significantly changed. The additional cost for upgrades has been reduced from 5,000 per time to 2,000 per time. The remaining changes are as follows:
Laser towers: from 10,000-37,000 to 4,200-54,700
Rifle tower: From 10,000-37,000 to 4,200-54,700
Vampire Tower: From 5,000-50,000 to 3,000-90,800

Missile towers: from 10,000-10,000 to 5,000-27,500
Support stations: from 10,000-10,000 to 5,000-27,500
Interception towers: from 5,000-50,000 to 4,200-54,700

Artillery towers: from 10,000 to 37,000 to 5,700 to 73,000
Shield tower: from 5,000-50,000 to 4,000-121,000
Machine gun towers: from 5,000-50,000 to 8,000-44,000

Sniper Tower: From 10,000-37,000 to 6,000-181,500
Drones: from 5,000 to 50,000 to 5,700 to 73,000
Power station: from 5,000-50,000 to 25,000-70,000

Income: From 8,000 to 242,000 to 11,300 to 145,900
Electromagnetic deceleration: from 0-0 to 5000-14000
Building construction: from 5,000-5,000 to 5,000-14,000

After the modification, you can reach the maximum income level more quickly. The upgrade cost curve for some units that increase significantly after reaching the maximum level has become steeper. This means that you can selectively upgrade more types of units instead of raising one type of unit to the maximum level all at once.

notes.title: 2025/5/2 Update
notes.content:
[h3] Gameplay Update [/h3]
The function of immediately dismantling and returning full resources when construction is suspended now is only valid for units that directly build. Even if the operation of upgrading the basic tower to the advanced tower is suspended, only half of the resources will be returned.
This function is mainly designed to prevent it from being placed askew during construction, but it cannot be placed askew during the upgrade operation.
In addition, previously, this would lead to you being able to completely dismantle the foundation tower by upgrading it during the pause and then selling it, especially having a significant impact on issues like power stations.
[h3]Bug Fix [/h3]
Fixed the issue where it was impossible to build a power station when the power demand exceeded the power supply by more than 100% after the power station explosion.
2. Fixed the issue where the "greed" factor would increase the power supply of the power station.

notes.title: 2025/5/1 Update
notes.content:
[h2] New unit [/h2]
Machine gun tower [/h3]
1. Ordinary machine gun tower: It targets the ground, has a very fast rate of fire, a slow rotation speed, and requires a large amount of power. The initial dispersion is 0. During continuous attack, it will overheat and increase the dispersion to the upper limit within 10 seconds. When the attack stops, the overheating will decay at the same rate. Operational efficiency will accelerate the rate of overheating without affecting the attenuation of overheating.
2. Heavy machine gun tower: Ground attack, initial rate of fire 0, dispersion 0. Continuous attack overheating will increase the rate of fire to extremely fast and the dispersion to extremely large. The demand for electricity is extremely high.
3. Lightweight machine gun tower: Reduces damage to ground and air, and increases rotation speed.
The horizontal component distributed by the machine gun tower is much larger than the vertical component.
Specialization: Increase accuracy by 20% (1/scatter) and reduce power demand by 5%
[h3] Power Station [/h3
1. Ordinary power station: Increase power supply by 100. When destroyed, the explosion will cause damage within the range that ignores friend or foe, distance attenuation, and armor.
Dismantling a power station not only fails to return resources but also requires ten times the cost of resources. Upgrading an ordinary power station to an advanced one will normally return the resources of the ordinary power station.
2. Energy-saving power stations: The unit electricity demand within the range is reduced by 30%.
3. Resource power station: 50% of the unit electricity demand within the range of income increase. This income is influenced by income specialization and is not affected by the decline at night.
The halo of the power station does not accumulate. Within the range refers to the distance being less than the range plus the size of the target, that is, the range circle and the unit selection circle intersect.
The unit occupying the mining machine in the tutorial has been changed to a power station.
Specialization: Increase power supply to power stations by 10% and reduce dismantling costs by 5%.
[h2] Gameplay Update [/h2]
The revenue from mining machines has dropped from 100 to 60. The basic power supply has been reduced from 5,000 to 200.
[h2]Bug Fix [/h2]
Fixed the issue where the halo was provided before the enhanced shield tower was completed.

notes.title: 2025/4/28 Update2
notes.content:
[h3]New unit[/h3]
Interception tower
1. Normal Interception Tower: Intercept nearby enemy trajectories, instant fire, damage 2.
2. Quick Interception Tower: Can store 16 attacks, with damage of 1
3. Rebound Interception Tower: It can rebound the enemy's trajectory. The cooldown time is the remaining health of the intercepted trajectory *1 second. It will not target bomber bombs. (But the first two can intercept.)
The attack effect of the rebound interception tower: Alter the shell formation, reverse the shell speed, remove the shell target unit, and set the target position as the location of the firing unit.

notes.title: 2025/4/28 Update
notes.content:
[h3] New unit [/h3]
Vampire tower system
1. Vampire Tower: It has very low damage, 100% ground and armor penetration, and restores 200% of its own damage health when attacking.
2. Shared Vampire Tower: Reduces damage, increases range. If your own health is full, transfer the excess healing amount to the friendly building with the lowest percentage of health within range.
3. Recycle the Vampire Tower: Reduces healing to 100%, but gains 50% damage when attacking.
Specialization: Increases health intake by 30% and health cap by 40%, without affecting damage or acquired resources.
Note: Income specialization now affects all forms of income, such as the income from recycling vampire towers.
[h3] Model Update [/h3]
Three models of shield towers have been updated.
2. Three models of sniper towers have been updated.
3. The model of the gunboat has been updated.
[h3] Gameplay Update [/h3]
The missile's steering has been optimized. Previously, the missile would sway left and right at low frame rates, but now it won't. Now the missile turns to a fixed turning radius.
2. The main gun of the gunboat now has a horizontal rotating shaft, making it easier to hit.
3. The Air Superiority aircraft now has two types of weapons. The main weapon is the previous missile, which is launched forward. The secondary weapon is a fast missile, launched backward, with an extremely fast rate of fire, a very small turning radius, low damage, random priority, and the secondary weapon constantly changes the target.
The response rate of air superiority aircraft has increased from 5% to 10%.
4. Electromagnetic deceleration will now reduce the blood return speed.
[h3]Bug Fix [/h3]
The engine effects of the three air forces have now been changed to the same form as those of the enemies, so there will no longer be rendering issues at high frame rates. And the frame rate will also increase slightly.
[h3] Other Updates [/h3]
The camera tracking and interpolation have been optimized. Now, the gradual interpolation and time interval binding of the camera have been achieved, thus reducing the impact of frame rate on the camera.

notes.title: 2025/4/16Update
notes.content:
[h3] Model update [/h3]
1. Updated three artillery tower models.
[h3]UI Update [/h3]
1. Updated the ICONS of some units.
[h3]Bug fix [/h3]
1. Fixed an issue where units were built without considering the impact of expertise on power demand.
2. Fixed an issue where drones stalled when the target changed repeatedly.
Previously, the drone would immediately return to the base station when the current target was killed, and would fly back toward the target when it regained the target, because there was a short gap between the death of the target and the acquisition of the next target so the drone would turn repeatedly.
Now the drone will not return to the base station until it has lost the target for more than 1 second, otherwise it will continue to fly towards the previous target position, so it will be more coherent.

notes.title: 2025/4/9Update
notes.content:
[h3] Model update [/h3]
1. Updated three support station models.
[h3]UI Update [/h3]
1. Added buttons and buttons for the new support station.
2. The map now shows shell health. (If it can be intercepted)
3. Units within the ability's scope now display blood bars. (If the residual blood display is turned on)
[h3] Gameplay Update [/h3]
1. Support stations now cancel trajectories, dealing damage to enemies in cylindrical range and healing to friendly forces, without being affected by range decay. Cooling increased from 120s to 240s.
2. Advanced Support Station is now renamed Attack Support Station. Now Skill 2 needs to select the area, will only randomly hit the enemies in the area, the area of action is proportional to the number. The number of strikes is number *10, CD120s, and lasts for 10s.
3. Add a new support station to upgrade the building, defensive support station, additional skill 3, release an invincible collision free ball at the target location. The ball will randomly intercept the trajectory in the target area, the intercept damage is 1, and the area of the range is proportional to the number. The number of interceptions is number x 100, CD120s, and lasts for 30s.
The interception effect is the same as that of the guard robot in the third level, the shell health of the ordinary tank is 1, the larger the shell health is higher.

notes.title: 2025/4/4Update
notes.content:
[h3] Model update [/h3]
1. Updated three missile tower models
[h3]UI Update [/h3]
1. Optimized the interaction between skills and removal functions during pause.
2. The now selected Build Unit type button will turn green. The Tear Down button and the Build Unit button can now light up at the same time.
3. Now if the unit type to be built is selected when the demolition button is opened, it will be considered as the demolition type.
4. The maximum range and increase speed of demolition have been doubled.
5. Added some random background descriptions to some player units.
[h3] Balance update [/h3]
1. The vertical missile tower was reworked to electromagnetic damage, now the vertical missile will deal full damage to the main target when hit, and total full damage to other enemies in the damage range, regardless of damage distance attenuation.
2. Reduced the damage of electromagnetic artillery tower and electromagnetic sniper tower.
3. The range of the missile tower system has been increased, the ballistic speed concentration has been reduced, and the missile acceleration is now capped at 200m/s.
4. The ground passable area of the beach area of the coast pass has been enlarged, now it is to the sea, before it was a fixed height area above, so the ground enemy can not pass far away from the sea.
5. Armor piercing artillery tower changed to damage by the units within the damage range to share the full amount of damage, not affected by damage distance attenuation, hit the main target and other targets in the same range of treatment.
6. All Boss bodies and targets are now free from normal splash damage.
[h3]Bug fix [/h3]
1. Fixed an issue where the BGM volume was set to 0 and then increased without BGM, but it would be played from the beginning.
2. Fixed an issue where the tower was sold for unlimited extra money when suspended.

notes.title: 2025/3/28Update
notes.content:
[h3] Model update [/h3]
1. Updated three rifle tower models.
[h3]UI Update [/h3]
1. It is now impossible to select a unit when opening Skill 1, and it will be forced to close when selecting a build unit. (Like selling switches)
2. Now the coastal platform cannot be locked in perspective, and the interaction between the coastal platform and the perspective lock is the same as when the unit is not selected.
[h3] Balance update [/h3]
1. Night Miner revenue reduced from 80% to 70%, range reduction reduced from 40% to 30%, enemies gain 40% retardation resistance. That is to say, when the electromagnetic deceleration effect is less than 40%, it is ineffective against the enemy, and when it is maximum, it is only 60%.
2. The multiple attack interval of sniper tower and electromagnetic sniper tower has been increased from 0.5s to 0.8s, and the multiple attack interval of resonant sniper tower has been increased from 0.5s to 1s. And Sniper Tower expertise no longer affects multiple attack intervals. Therefore, in the case of full specialization, the sniper tower will no longer complete the attack instantaneously, but will almost continue to multiple attacks until the next attack.
Note: The multiple attack interval is the time required to complete all multiple attacks.
3. Support Station Specialization changed from "Support Station Efficiency +50% (including skill built-in cd)" to "Support Station Efficiency +30% (including skill built-in cd) Power demand -5%"
4. Long Range rifle tower cooldown increased from 1s to 2s, damage increased from 75 to 100, 0.5s front shake increased, range bonus reduced from doubling every 20m to doubling every 40m.
5. Electromagnetic Rifle tower damage reduced from 60 to 50.
[h3]Bug fix [/h3]
1. Fixed an issue where the rifle tower system had no damage.

notes.title: 2025/3/26Update2
notes.content:
The frame count was optimized a bit.
[h3]UI Update [/h3]
1. The map now shows the weapon DPS, note that this DPS is the panel DPS, for example, the DPS of the missile nest tower shows the instant burst DPS instead of the continuous output DPS.
2. Some descriptions of the guide have been modified.
[h3] Balance update [/h3]
The numerical relationship between the base tower and the upgrade tower is adjusted so that the upgrade tower is always inferior to the base tower in some aspects, rather than simply enhanced.
Significantly reduced the power demand of the advanced tower, the ratio of power demand of the four levels was about 1：3：9：27, now it is 1：2：4：8, but also reduced the damage of the advanced tower.
You can almost cover the floor with a high level tower now, but not a low level tower.
Specific value changes can be compared in previous versions of Properties - Beta.
Some changes are as follows:
1. The damage of basic laser towers is higher than that of advanced laser towers.
2. The base rifle tower has a higher range than the electromagnetic rifle tower.
3. Drop missile tower damage reduced by half.
4. Hardened shield cooldown increased from 30s to 60s, and strengthened shield cooldown increased from 30s to 40s.
5. Sniper Tower damage reduced, cooldown increased, range increased. The electromagnetic sniper tower has the closest range. Sniper Tower damage reduced from 4000 to 1500, but maximum bonus damage increased from 2 to 4.
6. Satellite damage reduced from 1000 to 500, but power demand reduced from 100 to 50, and cost reduced from 25,000 to 15,000.
[h3]Bug fix [/h3]
1. Fixed the problem of calculating the trajectory of two kinds of self-burst artillery due to the change of gravity mechanism.

notes.title: 2025/3/26Update
notes.content:
[h3] Model update [/h3]
1. Updated three models of laser towers.
[h3]UI Update [/h3]
1. Replaced a BGM
2. Unit panel redisplays DPS and armor.
3. The map now shows the special bonus effect.
4. The main menu places some units for easy color adjustment.
[h3] Balance update [/h3]
1. Rifle Tower Specialization changed from "Rifle Tower range +10m ballistic speed +20% armor penetration +10%" to "Rifle Tower range +20% ballistic speed +20% armor penetration +10%"
2. Long Range rifle Tower damage increased from 5 times to 1 times every 20m. As a result, the long range rifle can do up to 11 times damage with full expertise.
3. Double the health of the fourth Boss.
4. Laser Tower damage reduced from 70 to 50, rotation speed increased from 2 to 3. Charging laser tower charging time reduced from 60s to 30s.
[h3]Bug fix [/h3]
1. Fixed an issue where torpedoes do not rewire enemies.

notes.title: 2025/3/23Update
notes.content:
[h3]UI Update [/h3]
1. Charging and augmenting lasers now display charging ratios in the unit panel. Modified the description.
2. The map now shows the ballistic speed.
[h3] Balance update [/h3]
1. The maximum charging time of the charging laser tower is increased from 30s to 60s, and the range can be increased by up to 100m with the charging time.
The charge and release rate of the charged laser tower is now related to the operational efficiency.
2. Missile Tower specialization changed from "Missile tower ballistic speed +20m/s damage range +10m (area superposition)" to "Missile tower ballistic speed +20m/s damage range +30% (area superposition)"
3. Artillery Tower specialization changed from "Artillery Tower Cooling rate +30% damage area +15m (area overlay)" to "Artillery Tower Cooling rate +30% ballistic speed +20%"
4. Missile tower damage radius increased from 5m to 10m, and missile nest tower damage increased from 200 to 300.
5. Laser Tower Specialization changed from "Laser Tower Range +15m damage +30%" to "Laser Tower range +10m damage +30%".
6. Rifle Tower Specialization changed from "Rifle tower range +15m ballistic speed +30% armor penetration +10%" to "Rifle Tower range +10m ballistic speed +20% armor penetration +10%".
7. The maximum charging time of the laser tower is increased from 10s to 20s, the maximum damage radius is increased from 10m to 20m, and the decay ratio is reduced from 5 to 2.
[h3] Mechanism update [/h3]
1. The firing mode of curved fire weapons (such as artillery towers with fixed firing angles) changed from fixed gravity to adjust ballistic speed to fixed speed to adjust gravity.
Now the firing trajectory rate of curved and non-gravity weapons is the numerical trajectory rate, and the horizontal component of the firing trajectory velocity of flat-fired gravity weapons is the numerical trajectory rate.
Under the previous mechanism, the actual ballistic rate of a curved weapon is approximately square root proportional to the target distance.
Due to this change, the actual ballistic rate of the curved weapon may vary slightly.
2. The unit ballistic collision shutdown condition has changed from explosion to health less than or equal to 0, so the Air Force will now lose ballistic collision before landing.
3. Ballistic target enemy loses condition from unit disappearance to health less than or equal to 0.
[h3]Bug fix [/h3]
1. Fixed an issue where the health of the drone was not affected by specialization when it left the factory.

notes.title: 2025/3/22Update
notes.content:
[h3]UI Update [/h3]
1. Updated the description of some illustrations.
2. Modified description of torpedo cost upgrade.
3. The drone base station now displays the construction progress on the unit panel.
[h3] Balance update [/h3]
1. Drone Specialization changed from "50% increased Damage" to "40% increased damage and 30% increased Health". Adjusted the price of drone expertise.
2. Satellite now has 500 Health and will lose 10 health per second when attacked. Damage increases to 11 times over the course of 20 seconds. Damage changed from 1500 to 1000.
The satellite base station takes 60 seconds to build, and unlike other base stations, no additional one is stored.
In other words, satellites are now better suited to hitting large units, and upgrading drone expertise will allow satellites to attack for longer.
It is worth noting that because the satellite attack blood rate is fixed, the higher the satellite damage, the less blood the unit damage, which means that the specialization upgrade will make the satellite combat time increase twice instead of once.
3. Cruisers and carriers are now rated D, so that high-priority attack units can be locked properly.
[h3] New Feature Update [/h3]
1. Add color matching system, you can modify the primary and secondary color matching of player units in the Settings, this function will only affect some units at present. (Resonant sniper tower and drone base station)
Clicking the Player color button in Settings hides the Settings panel, so you can visually look at the units in the scene to make changes.
In addition, if you want to take a value of hsv to 0 or 1, just hold down the mouse and drag it out of the range.
[h3]Bug fix [/h3]
1. Fixed an issue where platforms could take damage from friendly forces.

notes.title: 2025/3/20Update2
notes.content:
[h3]UI Update [/h3]
1. Added the shortcut key Esc to switch the menu. After opening the menu, right-click to close it
2. Fixed a Bug where menu buttons sometimes need to be clicked twice.
3. Added pause visual effect.
4. Fixed the problem of incomplete display of part of the map and changed the description of the resonant sniper tower.
5. Added the description of the fourth level.
[h3] Balance update [/h3]
1. Cruiser and carrier health reduced to 60%, recovery reduced from 1% to 0.5%.
2. The terrain height determination of building units now takes the maximum of ground and water, so torpedo damage to ships is no longer subject to terrain gain.
3. Torpedo damage reduced from 20,000 to 10,000, torpedo cost increased from 500 to 1000.
4. Vertical missile tower range increased from 200 to 300, damage radius increased from 10 to 20.
[h3]Bug fix [/h3]
1. Fixed the problem of not disappearing when the blood amount of blood is greater than 0 after the unit dies due to blood sucking factors.
2. Fixed an issue where ships could not disappear due to their slow sinking speed when stuck on the edge of a water body.

notes.title: 2025/3/20 Update, new level "Coast"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415393/869be505996c71b4af868f1e6b5ba677724bd66b.png[/img]
[h1] Added a new level "Coast" [/h1]
1. New levels add naval enemies and new neutral units.
[h1] Updated UI[/h1]
1. The tutorial has been simplified and moved to a level selection interface.
2. Added the map system, you can view the details of the unit and the game mechanism, click the unit icon in the game can jump to the corresponding map.
3. "Additional Upgrades" is now called "Specialization".
4. Simplified UI, now build lists divided into ABCD four levels, toggled by buttons or 1234 shortcuts. The unit panel now displays only the most basic properties, and details are included in the map.
5. Added terrain quality Settings, the default is high, the previous quality is close to the current highest option. When the camera looks up, it will see a large area of the ground, and in such cases the quality of the terrain greatly affects the frame count.
[h1] Change maintenance cost system to electric system [/h1]
1. Units no longer need to consume resources continuously after they are built.
2. Revenue concentration no longer increases recycling rates.
3. Increased the power system (i.e., population). The value is similar to the previous maintenance cost.
Every unit that exists will increase electricity demand, and the total electricity demand cannot be greater than the total electricity supply. At present, the total power supply is fixed at 5000.
[h1] Some units have been modified [/h1]
1. The electromagnetic artillery tower is changed to low damage and high rate of fire, and the armor-piercing artillery tower is changed to low rate of fire and high ballistic speed to enhance differentiation.
2. Vertical missile towers will now track enemies, but with limited range.
3. Satellite base stations are now within the same range as other drone base stations.

notes.title: 2025/2/14 Update
notes.content:
Added acceleration mode.
In Turbo mode, the duration of each level has been reduced from 60 minutes to 30 minutes, and the number of enemies remains the same.
Miner activation speed is doubled, and income and maintenance expenses are doubled.

notes.title: 2025/2/13 Update
notes.content:
1. Added tutorial levels.
2. Cancel the random upgrade and spend resources to upgrade instead.
3. The Electromagnetic Sniper Tower has reduced its damage, but now it will bounce 4 times, reducing the damage by 30% each time.
4. Skills and Sell Tower switches can now be turned off by pressing the right button.

notes.title: 2025/2/7 Update
notes.content:
1. Added difficulty options to change the percentage of enemy HP
Casual 20%, Easy 40%, Medium 70%, Hard 100%
2. Added monster spawn logo
When an enemy enters the map, a red icon will flash at the edge of the screen, which can be turned off in the settings.
3. Added two shortcut keys for skills, selling towers, and locking attacks.
Skill 1 and Sell Tower are now toggle switches, and it is no longer necessary to hold down shift to release continuously.
When the tower is open, the rolling pulley can change the sell range.
When selecting an enemy unit, you can lock on to attack so that it is targeted first.

notes.title: 2025/2/4 Update
notes.content:
The game difficulty has been reduced and the level flow has been adjusted. The pressure in the early game has been alleviated. The first-level tower now has a cheap AOE to deal with the early waves. Some of the changes are as follows:
1. The armor of the "Regular Tank" has been reduced from 50% to 20%, and its health has been decreased from 1000 to 800. This means that the number of attacks required to destroy it with non-piercing weapons is halved.
2. The range of the long-range rifle tower, missile tower series, and artillery tower series has been increased.
3. The maximum damage multiplier of the sustained attack of the Amplification Laser Tower has been reduced from 3 to 2, but it can now obtain a splash damage radius of 10m during sustained attacks.
4. The attack interval of the Electromagnetic Rifle Tower has been increased from 0.5s to 1s, but it can now obtain a splash damage radius of 10m.
5. The number of mining machines in the Icefield level has been increased from 4 to 8, and the maximum income has been increased from 5000 to 8000. 

The default game difficulty has been reduced. You can choose a difficulty factor to increase the game difficulty.
